notes.title: JULY DEV UPDATE
notes.notes:
Due to a known bug, Edge of Dawn no longer appears as Early Access.  I know many of you would like to get your hands on Edge of Dawn as soon as possible, so I’ve decided to adjust to a full release in order to shorten the delay. The release date is now July 15, @1:00pm CDT.
